body:
emily.chen: POC blocker - streaming + tool_call yields malformed JSON for customer. Repro below.
rachel_sales: Which customer and endpoint?
emily.chen: NovaBank, hosted /v1/chat.completions, model redwood-xy-2-large. They call `risk_check` tool and expect a single JSON object. Works with stream=false, fails with stream=true.
marco_dev: Can you paste the sanitized stream chunks?
emily.chen: Sanitized stream: 
[chunk] {"role":"tool","name":"risk_check","content":"{\"risk\":\"low\"}"} 
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"
Note: risk verified, returning payload"} 
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"
{\"verdict\":{\"score\":0.04}}"} 
[end stream]

sara_ops: Customer stack: 
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 142, in on_message
    parsed = json.loads(accumulated)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 127 (char 126)

marco_dev: Root cause: assistant injected a plain-text summary between tool output and final JSON, so naive concatenation fails. We have an eng-runtime PR to add framing tokens and a strict_json_stream option to abort on non-JSON tokens. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/5128
deploy-bot: CI queued for PR 5128. Unit tests: 389 passed, integration flaky tests: 4/6 failing, retrying.
rachel_sales: Sales questions: 1) provisional Dedicated eval price for 4x-A100 equiv? 2) ETA for runtime fix? 3) security QSA reply for encryption/tls?
emily.chen: Quick answers: pricing ballpark $40k/mo list for 4x-A100 equiv; we can offer a 30-day eval credit with a trial discount (TBD with finance). Runtime fix ETA: eng estimates internal canary in ~72 hours, GA ~10 business days if CI stabilizes. QSA: security needs the questionnaire; we can confirm TLS 1.2+ by default and recommend TLS1.3 for Dedicated; KMS options available for Private.
marco_dev: Short-term mitigations: 1) ask customer to set stream=false while we triage; 2) use a system prompt: "STRICT_JSON_OUTPUT: output exactly one JSON object, no commentary or code fences"; 3) SDK-side: assemble only assistant chunks after tool_end and strip surrounding backticks before json.loads, then validate and retry if invalid.
marco_dev: Mini mitigation snippet (pseudo):
buf = ''
for ev in stream:
  if ev['role'] == 'assistant':
    buf += ev['content']
buf = re.sub(r"^```+|```+$","",buf)
try:
  parsed = json.loads(buf)
except Exception:
  # fall back to non-streaming or request retry
  raise

sara_ops: Action items: emily -> send provisional quote and schedule triage call with customer + eng; marco -> post PR link and notify when canary starts; rachel -> collect customer questionnaire and loop security; deploy-bot -> post CI updates.
emily.chen: Thanks team, I'll sync with customer and share mitigations. :thumbsup:
